purpose: Clinical research to improve public health planning.
question: For adults with obesity, report latest BMI counts and means per region.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient.
Report per region: adults with obesity who have a BMI value and their mean BMI, one decimal.
